bake.zh: 我妈妈为我的生日烤了一个蛋糕。

ballet.en: She has studied ballet since she was five.
ballet.zh: 她从五岁起就学习芭蕾舞。

bank account.en: He opened a bank account last week.
bank account.zh: 他上周开了一个银行账户。

basin.en: She washed her face in the basin.

bathrobe.en: He put on a warm bathrobe after showering.
bathrobe.zh: 他洗完澡后穿上了一件温暖的浴衣。

battleground.en: The old town was once a famous battleground.
battleground.zh: 这座古城曾经是一个著名的战场。

bc.en: The castle was built around 300 BC.
bc.zh: 这座城堡建于大约公元前300年。

beam.en: The gymnast walked carefully along the beam.
beam.zh: 体操运动员沿着平衡木小心地走着。

beancurd.en: My grandmother often cooks beancurd with vegetables.
beancurd.zh: 我奶奶经常用蔬菜烧豆腐。

bedclothes.en: She washed all the bedclothes on Sunday.
bedclothes.zh: 她星期天洗了所有的被褥。

beddings.en: We bought new beddings for the guest room.
beddings.zh: 我们为客房买了新的卧具。

beehive.en: The farmer keeps a beehive near his garden.
beehive.zh: 农民在花园附近养了一个蜂箱。

behaviour.en: His behaviour in class was very good today.
behaviour.zh: 他今天在课堂上的表现很好。

belgium.en: Belgium is famous for its chocolate and beer.
belgium.zh: 比利时以巧克力和啤酒闻名。

beneath.en: The cat is sleeping beneath the wooden table.

beneficial.en: Daily exercise is beneficial to your health.
beneficial.zh: 每天锻炼对你的健康有益。

benefit.en: Regular exercise will benefit your whole body.
benefit.zh: 经常锻炼会使你的整个身体受益。

best--seller.en: This novel became a best-seller last year.
best--seller.zh: 这部小说去年成了畅销书。

bingo.en: We played bingo at the school party.
bingo.zh: 我们在学校聚会上玩了宾戈游戏。

biochemistry.en: She wants to study biochemistry at university.
biochemistry.zh: 她想在大学学习生物化学。

biography.en: I am reading a biography of a scientist.
biography.zh: 我正在读一位科学家的传记。

birdcage.en: The birdcage hangs by the front window.

birthplace.en: This small town is his birthplace.
birthplace.zh: 这个小镇是他的出生地。

biscuit.en: He ate a biscuit with his tea.
biscuit.zh: 他就着茶吃了一块饼干。

bishop.en: The bishop gave a speech at the church.
bishop.zh: 主教在教堂里发表了讲话。

blank.en: Please fill in each blank with one word.
blank.zh: 请在每个空格里填一个词。

boat--race.en: Our school won the boat race this year.
boat--race.zh: 我们学校今年赢了划船比赛。

boating.en: We went boating on the lake last Sunday.
boating.zh: 上周日我们去湖上划船了。

body--building.en: He does bodybuilding three times a week.
body--building.zh: 他每周做三次健美运动。

bond.en: A strong bond grew between the two sisters.
bond.zh: 两姐妹之间产生了牢固的纽带。

bone.en: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
bone.zh: 狗在花园里埋了一根骨头。

bonus.en: All the workers received a bonus this month.
bonus.zh: 所有工人这个月都拿到了一笔奖金。

bookshop.en: I bought this dictionary at a small bookshop.
bookshop.zh: 我在一家小书店买了这本词典。

telephone booth.en: He called his mother from a telephone booth.
telephone booth.zh: 他在电话亭给妈妈打了电话。

botanical.en: We visited the botanical garden last weekend.
botanical.zh: 上周末我们参观了植物园。

botany.en: She is studying botany at the university.

boundary.en: The river forms the boundary between two countries.
boundary.zh: 这条河形成了两国之间的边界。

boycott.en: Many people boycotted the company's products.
boycott.zh: 许多人抵制这家公司的产品。

brake.en: He put his foot on the brake and stopped.
brake.zh: 他踩下刹车，把车停了下来。

bravery.en: Her bravery saved the little boy from the fire.
bravery.zh: 她的勇气把那个小男孩从火里救了出来。

breakthrough.en: Scientists made a big breakthrough in cancer research.
breakthrough.zh: 科学家在癌症研究中取得了重大突破。

breast.en: The mother held her baby to her breast.

breathless.en: Tom was breathless after running up the hill.
breathless.zh: 汤姆跑上山后气喘吁吁。

brewery.en: My uncle works in a small brewery near the river.
brewery.zh: 我叔叔在河边一家小啤酒厂工作。

brick.en: The old wall was built of red brick.
brick.zh: 那堵老墙是用红砖砌成的。

bridegroom.en: The bridegroom looked very happy at the wedding.
bridegroom.zh: 新郎在婚礼上显得非常幸福。

the british.en: The British like to talk about the weather.

brotherhood.en: The two soldiers felt a deep brotherhood after the war.
brotherhood.zh: 战后，这两名士兵之间有了深厚的兄弟情谊。

brunch.en: We had brunch at eleven and skipped lunch.
brunch.zh: 我们十一点吃了早午饭，就没吃午饭。

buddhist.en: My friend Amy is a Buddhist and often visits the temple.
buddhist.zh: 我朋友艾米是佛教徒，常去寺庙。

bun.en: Mary bought a sweet bun for breakfast.
bun.zh: 玛丽买了一个小甜面包当早饭。

bungalow.en: They live in a small bungalow with a garden.
bungalow.zh: 他们住在一栋带花园的小平房里。

burden.en: Caring for four children is a heavy burden.
burden.zh: 照顾四个孩子是沉重的负担。

bureaucratic.en: The bureaucratic rules made this simple job very slow.
bureaucratic.zh: 官僚的规定让这件简单的工作进展很慢。

burial.en: The burial took place on a quiet hill.
burial.zh: 埋葬仪式在一座安静的小山上举行。

bus stop.en: I wait for the bus at the bus stop.
bus stop.zh: 我在公共汽车站等公交车。

businesswoman.en: The businesswoman runs three shops in our town.
businesswoman.zh: 这位女商人在我们镇上经营三家商店。

butcher.en: The butcher cut the meat into small pieces.

the butterfly.en: He swam the butterfly and won the race.

bye.en: Bye, see you tomorrow after school.

cabbage.en: My mother cooked cabbage with pork for dinner.
cabbage.zh: 妈妈晚饭做了猪肉炒卷心菜。

calculate.en: Please calculate the total cost of the trip.
calculate.zh: 请计算一下这次旅行的总费用。

campaign.en: They started a campaign to save the old trees.
campaign.zh: 他们发起了一场保护老树的运动。

a garbage can.en: He threw the empty bottle into a garbage can.
a garbage can.zh: 他把空瓶子扔进了垃圾桶。

a can opener.en: Mary could not find a can opener in the kitchen.
a can opener.zh: 玛丽在厨房里找不到开罐器。

cance.en: Smoking can cause cancer and other serious diseases.
cance.zh: 吸烟可能导致癌症和其他严重疾病。

canteen.en: We have lunch in the school canteen every day.
canteen.zh: 我们每天在学校食堂吃午饭。

capsule.en: The doctor told him to take one capsule daily.
capsule.zh: 医生让他每天吃一粒胶囊。

caption.en: The caption under the photo explains what happened.
caption.zh: 照片下面的说明文字解释了发生了什么。

carbon.en: Carbon is found in all living things.
carbon.zh: 碳存在于所有生物体内。

card games.en: We played card games on the train.
card games.zh: 我们在火车上玩纸牌游戏。

carriage.en: The old carriage was pulled by two white horses.
carriage.zh: 那辆旧四轮马车由两匹白马拉着。

carrier.en: The bicycle carrier can hold a small bag.
carrier.zh: 自行车的置物架可以放一个小包。

cartoon.en: Tom watches a cartoon every Saturday morning.
cartoon.zh: 汤姆每周六早上都看动画片。

carve.en: My father can carve animals out of wood.
carve.zh: 我爸爸能用木头雕出动物。

cassettle.en: She put an old cassette into the player.
cassettle.zh: 她把一盘旧磁带放进播放机里。

cast.en: He cast the fishing line into the river.
cast.zh: 他把钓鱼线抛进了河里。

casual.en: He wore casual clothes to the party.
casual.zh: 他穿着便装去参加聚会。

catalogue.en: I found the price in the shop catalogue.
catalogue.zh: 我在商店目录里找到了价格。

catastrophe.en: The flood was a catastrophe for the whole village.
catastrophe.zh: 这场洪水对整个村子来说是一场灾难。

category.en: These books belong to the same category.

cater.en: They cater for large weddings and family parties.
cater.zh: 他们为大型婚礼和家庭聚会承办酒席。

catholic.en: My grandmother goes to a Catholic church on Sundays.
catholic.zh: 我奶奶每周日去天主教堂。

cathedral.en: We visited a huge cathedral in the old city.
cathedral.zh: 我们参观了老城里一座巨大的教堂。

caution.en: Please drive with caution on the wet road.
caution.zh: 在湿滑的路上请小心驾驶。

cd-rom.en: This CD-ROM holds a large English dictionary.
cd-rom.zh: 这张光盘里存着一部大型英语词典。

celebration.en: The whole town joined the celebration that night.
celebration.zh: 那天晚上全镇的人都参加了庆祝活动。

cellar.en: We keep potatoes and apples in the cellar.
cellar.zh: 我们把土豆和苹果存放在地窖里。

centimetre.en: The box is about twenty centimetres long.
centimetre.zh: 这个盒子大约二十厘米长。

certificate.en: She got a certificate after finishing the course.
certificate.zh: 完成课程后她拿到了一张证书。

chain.en: The dog was tied to a tree with a chain.
chain.zh: 那条狗被一根链条拴在树上。

chain store.en: This chain store sells cheap clothes in every city.
chain store.zh: 这家连锁店在每个城市都卖便宜衣服。

chairwoman.en: The chairwoman opened the meeting with a smile.
chairwoman.zh: 女主席微笑着宣布会议开始。

challenging.en: This new game is challenging but great fun.
challenging.zh: 这个新游戏很有挑战性，但也很好玩。

changeable.en: The weather here is changeable in spring.
changeable.zh: 这里春天的天气变化无常。

channel.en: Please change the channel to watch the news.

chant.en: The crowd chanted the name of their team.
chant.zh: 人群反复高喊他们球队的名字。

chaos.en: The city was in chaos after the big storm.
chaos.zh: 大风暴过后，城市陷入一片混乱。

chart.en: The chart shows the number of students each year.
chart.zh: 这张图表显示了每年的学生人数。

cheer up.en: Cheer up, the exam will not be that hard.
cheer up.zh: 振作起来，考试不会那么难的。

chemist.en: The chemist gave me some medicine for my cough.
chemist.zh: 药剂师给了我一些治咳嗽的药。

cheque.en: He paid for the old car by cheque.
cheque.zh: 他用支票付了那辆旧车的钱。

chick.en: The little chick followed its mother around the yard.
chick.zh: 小鸡跟着妈妈在院子里走来走去。

choke.en: He began to choke on a piece of bread.

chorus.en: She sings in the school chorus every Thursday.
chorus.zh: 她每周四在学校合唱队唱歌。

christian.en: My neighbour is a Christian and goes to church.
christian.zh: 我邻居是基督徒，常去教堂。

christmas card.en: I sent a Christmas card to my English teacher.
christmas card.zh: 我给我的英语老师寄了一张圣诞卡。

christmas tree.en: We put a star on top of the Christmas tree.
christmas tree.zh: 我们在圣诞树顶上放了一颗星星。

christmas eve.en: The family sings songs together on Christmas Eve.
christmas eve.zh: 这家人圣诞前夜一起唱歌。

cinema.en: We went to the cinema on Friday evening.
cinema.zh: 我们周五晚上去了电影院。

circuit.en: The racing cars went round the circuit ten times.
circuit.zh: 赛车绕着环形赛道跑了十圈。

circulate.en: Blood circulates around the body all the time.

circumstance.en: Under these circumstances, we must change our plan.
circumstance.zh: 在这种情况下，我们必须改变计划。

civilian.en: Many civilians left the city during the war.
civilian.zh: 战争期间许多平民离开了这座城市。

civilization.en: Ancient Egypt had a rich and famous civilization.
civilization.zh: 古埃及拥有丰富而著名的文明。

classic.en: This is a classic example of good writing.
classic.zh: 这是优秀写作的一个典型例子。

classify.en: We classify the books by subject and age.
classify.zh: 我们按科目和年龄给这些书分类。

claw.en: The cat hurt its claw on the sharp fence.
claw.zh: 猫的爪子在尖栅栏上受了伤。

clay.en: The children made cups from wet clay.
clay.zh: 孩子们用湿黏土做杯子。

clone.en: The scientists made a clone of the sheep.
clone.zh: 科学家们培育出了那只羊的克隆体。

clumsy.en: Tom is a bit clumsy with his big hands.
clumsy.zh: 汤姆那双大手有点笨拙。

cock.en: The cock wakes us up every morning.
cock.zh: 公鸡每天早上把我们叫醒。

cocoa.en: She added cocoa to the hot milk.
cocoa.zh: 她在热牛奶里加了可可粉。

cold--blooded.en: Snakes are cold-blooded animals and need the sun.
cold--blooded.zh: 蛇是冷血动物，需要晒太阳。

collision.en: Two cars were badly damaged in the collision.
collision.zh: 两辆车在碰撞事故中严重受损。

combine.en: We combine work with fun in this class.
combine.zh: 我们在这个课上把工作和乐趣结合起来。

comedy.en: We watched a comedy and laughed a lot.
comedy.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，笑了很多。

comma.en: Put a comma between the two short clauses.
comma.zh: 在两个短分句之间加一个逗号。

commericia.en: The city is a busy commercial centre.
commericia.zh: 这座城市是繁忙的商业中心。

commitment.en: He made a commitment to help us every week.

communism.en: They studied the history of communism in class.
communism.zh: 他们在课上学习了共产主义的历史。

communist.en: My grandfather was a communist in his youth.
communist.zh: 我爷爷年轻时是一名共产主义者。

companion.en: The old dog was his only companion.
companion.zh: 那条老狗是他唯一的同伴。

compensate.en: The company will compensate us for the lost bags.
compensate.zh: 公司会赔偿我们丢失的包。

compete.en: Ten students will compete in the singing contest.
compete.zh: 十名学生将参加歌唱比赛。

competence.en: She showed great competence in her new job.
competence.zh: 她在新工作中表现出很强的能力。

competitor.en: Every competitor must wear a number on his back.
competitor.zh: 每位参赛者背上都必须戴号码布。

component.en: This small part is an important component of the machine.
component.zh: 这个小零件是这台机器的重要部件。

comprehension.en: My comprehension of the text improved after reading it twice.
comprehension.zh: 读了两遍之后，我对这篇文章的理解提高了。

compulsory.en: English is a compulsory subject in our school.
compulsory.zh: 英语是我们学校的一门必修课。

computer game.en: He plays a computer game after finishing his homework.
computer game.zh: 他做完作业后玩电子游戏。

comrade.en: The soldiers called each other comrade.

conclude.en: They concluded the meeting at five o'clock.
conclude.zh: 他们五点钟结束了会议。

condemn.en: Many people condemned the attack on the village.
condemn.zh: 许多人谴责了对村庄的袭击。

conductor.en: The conductor checked our tickets on the train.
conductor.zh: 列车员在火车上检查了我们的车票。

congratulate.en: We all congratulated Amy on winning the prize.

consensus.en: The team reached a consensus after a long talk.
consensus.zh: 经过长时间的讨论，团队达成了共识。

consequence.en: He lost his job as a consequence of that mistake.
consequence.zh: 由于那个错误，他失去了工作。

conservation.en: Wildlife conservation is important for the future of our planet.
conservation.zh: 野生动物保护对我们星球的未来很重要。

consistent.en: His story was consistent with the facts we had.
consistent.zh: 他的说法与我们掌握的事实一致。

consultant.en: The company hired a consultant to improve its service.
consultant.zh: 公司聘请了一位顾问来改进服务。

contradict.en: He did not dare to contradict his teacher in class.
contradict.zh: 他不敢在课上反驳老师。

contradictory.en: The two reports gave contradictory answers to the same question.
contradictory.zh: 两份报告对同一问题给出了相互矛盾的答案。

contribute.en: Everyone can contribute ideas to the school music festival.
contribute.zh: 每个人都能为学校音乐节贡献想法。

contribution.en: Her contribution to the project was very important.
contribution.zh: 她对这个项目的贡献非常重要。

convenience.en: Online shopping brings great convenience to busy working parents.
convenience.zh: 网上购物给忙碌的上班族父母带来了很大便利。

cooker.en: My mother bought a new rice cooker last week.
cooker.zh: 我妈妈上周买了一个新的电饭锅。

cordless.en: My father uses a cordless phone in the garden.
cordless.zh: 我爸爸在花园里用无绳电话。

corporation.en: He works for a large corporation in the city.
corporation.zh: 他在城里一家大公司工作。

correction.en: The teacher made a small correction on my paper.
correction.zh: 老师在我的试卷上做了一处小改正。

correspond.en: Mary and her pen friend correspond every month.
correspond.zh: 玛丽和她的笔友每月通信。

cosy.en: The small room felt warm and cosy in winter.
cosy.zh: 冬天这个小房间让人感到温暖舒适。

could modal.en: Could you help me carry this heavy box?
could modal.zh: 你能帮我搬这个很重的箱子吗？

courtyard.en: The children are playing games in the courtyard.
courtyard.zh: 孩子们正在院子里做游戏。

cowboy.en: The cowboy rode his horse across the wide field.
cowboy.zh: 牛仔骑着马穿过广阔的田野。

co-worker.en: My co-worker helped me finish the report on time.
co-worker.zh: 我的同事帮我按时完成了报告。

crayon.en: The little girl drew a red sun with a crayon.
crayon.zh: 小女孩用蜡笔画了一个红太阳。

create.en: Music can create a peaceful feeling in our hearts.
create.zh: 音乐能在我们心中创造一种平静的感觉。

criterion.en: Price is not the only criterion for choosing a school.
criterion.zh: 价格不是选择学校的唯一标准。

crossroads.en: Turn left at the next crossroads and you will see it.
crossroads.zh: 在下一个十字路口向左转，你就会看到它。

cubic.en: The box has a volume of two cubic metres.
cubic.zh: 这个盒子的体积是两立方米。

cuisine.en: The restaurant is famous for its spicy Sichuan cuisine.
cuisine.zh: 这家餐馆以麻辣的四川菜闻名。

currency.en: You need to change your money into local currency.
currency.zh: 你需要把钱兑换成当地货币。

curriculum.en: Our school added cooking to the curriculum this year.
curriculum.zh: 我们学校今年把烹饪加进了课程。

cushion.en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
cushion.zh: 她在背后放了一个软垫子。

cyclist.en: A cyclist stopped to help the old man.
cyclist.zh: 一位骑车人停下来帮助那位老人。

database.en: All the student information is kept in a database.
database.zh: 所有学生信息都保存在一个数据库里。

daylight.en: We could see the mountains clearly in the daylight.
daylight.zh: 在日光下我们能清楚地看到群山。

decade.en: The city has changed a lot in the last decade.
decade.zh: 这座城市在过去十年里变化很大。

decoration.en: The paper decorations made the classroom look bright and happy.
decoration.zh: 纸装饰让教室看起来明亮又欢快。

deliberately.en: He deliberately broke the window and then ran away.
deliberately.zh: 他故意打破窗户，然后跑掉了。

delicate.en: Be careful with the delicate glass cups on the table.
delicate.zh: 小心桌上那些易碎的玻璃杯。

department -store.en: She bought a warm coat at the department store.
department -store.zh: 她在百货商场买了一件暖和的外套。

devote.en: He devotes two hours a day to reading English.
devote.zh: 他每天把两个小时用于读英语。

devotion.en: Her devotion to teaching has touched all her students.
devotion.zh: 她对教学的奉献感动了她所有的学生。

diagram.en: The teacher drew a simple diagram of the heart.
diagram.zh: 老师画了一张简单的心脏示意图。

dictation.en: We have an English dictation every Monday morning.
dictation.zh: 我们每周一早上都有英语听写。

digest.en: It takes time for children to digest fatty food.
digest.zh: 孩子们消化油腻的食物需要时间。

dilemma.en: She was in a dilemma about which job to take.
dilemma.zh: 她在该接受哪份工作上陷入了两难。

dimension.en: Please measure the dimensions of the table for me.
dimension.zh: 请帮我量一下桌子的尺寸。

dine.en: We usually dine at seven in the evening.
dine.zh: 我们通常晚上七点吃饭。

dining-room.en: The family had dinner together in the dining-room.
dining-room.zh: 一家人在饭厅一起吃了晚饭。

dioxide.en: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen.
dioxide.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳，释放氧气。

diploma.en: He got his diploma after four years of study.
diploma.zh: 学习四年后他拿到了毕业文凭。

directory.en: I found her phone number in the telephone directory.
directory.zh: 我在电话簿里找到了她的电话号码。

disability.en: People with a disability need our help and respect.
disability.zh: 有残疾的人需要我们的帮助和尊重。

disabled.en: The new library has special seats for disabled people.
disabled.zh: 新图书馆为残疾人设有专门的座位。

disadvantage.en: The main disadvantage of the plan is its high cost.
disadvantage.zh: 这个计划的主要缺点是费用太高。

disgusting.en: The smell from the dustbin was really disgusting.
disgusting.zh: 垃圾箱里散发的气味真令人恶心。

disk.en: I saved all the photos on a disk.
disk.zh: 我把所有照片保存在一张磁盘上。

disobey.en: It is wrong to disobey the safety rules at school.
disobey.zh: 不遵守学校的安全规则是不对的。

distinction.en: There is a clear distinction between the two words.
distinction.zh: 这两个词之间有明显的区别。

distribute.en: They will distribute free books to the students tomorrow.
distribute.zh: 他们明天将向学生分发免费书籍。

dive.en: Tom likes to dive into the pool from the side.
dive.zh: 汤姆喜欢从池边跳进游泳池。

diverse.en: Our class has students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
diverse.zh: 我们班有来自不同文化背景的学生。

dizzy.en: She felt dizzy after running in the hot sun.
dizzy.zh: 在烈日下跑步后她感到头晕。

dormitory.en: The students clean their dormitory every Saturday morning.
dormitory.zh: 学生们每周六早上打扫宿舍。

dot.en: There is a small red dot on the map.

downward.en: The path goes downward to the small river.
downward.zh: 小路向下通向那条小河。

drawback.en: The only drawback of the flat is its small kitchen.
drawback.zh: 这套公寓唯一的缺点是厨房太小。

drier.en: Mum put the wet clothes into the drier.
drier.zh: 妈妈把湿衣服放进了烘干机。

drill.en: He used a drill to make a hole in the wall.
drill.zh: 他用钻头在墙上钻了一个洞。

dumpling.en: We eat dumplings with our family on New Year's Eve.
dumpling.zh: 除夕我们和家人一起吃饺子。

dustbin.en: Please throw the empty bottle into the dustbin.
dustbin.zh: 请把空瓶子扔进垃圾箱。

dusty.en: The old road becomes dusty on windy days.
dusty.zh: 这条老路在刮风天会变得尘土飞扬。

dvd.en: We watched a funny film on DVD last night.
dvd.zh: 昨晚我们用 DVD 看了一部有趣的电影。

dynamic.en: Amy is a dynamic student with many new ideas.
dynamic.zh: 艾米是个充满活力、主意很多的学生。

dynasty.en: The Ming Dynasty built many beautiful palaces in Beijing.
dynasty.zh: 明朝在北京修建了许多美丽的宫殿。

easter.en: We paint eggs and visit our grandparents at Easter.
easter.zh: 复活节时我们画彩蛋、看望祖父母。

eastern.en: The eastern part of the country is warmer.
eastern.zh: 这个国家的东部地区更暖和。

eastwards.en: The birds flew eastwards as the sun went down.
eastwards.zh: 太阳落下时，鸟儿向东飞去。

easy--going.en: My uncle is an easy-going man who rarely worries.
easy--going.zh: 我叔叔是个随和的人，很少发愁。

edition.en: This is the second edition of the English book.
edition.zh: 这是这本英语书的第二版。

educate.en: Parents should educate their children to be honest.
educate.zh: 父母应该教育孩子要诚实。

educator.en: The old educator wrote many books for young teachers.
educator.zh: 这位老教育家为年轻教师写了很多书。

egyptian.en: We learned about ancient Egyptian art in class.
egyptian.zh: 我们在课上了解了古埃及艺术。

encourage.en: My teacher encouraged me to try the speech contest.
encourage.zh: 老师鼓励我去参加演讲比赛。

endless.en: The long bus ride felt endless to the children.
endless.zh: 对孩子们来说，漫长的车程似乎没有尽头。

energ.en: The little boy has lots of energy after school.
energ.zh: 这个小男孩放学后精力充沛。

english -speaking.en: She works in an English-speaking country now.
english -speaking.zh: 她现在在一个说英语的国家工作。

enlarge.en: They plan to enlarge the school library next year.
enlarge.zh: 他们计划明年扩大学校图书馆。

enquiry.en: I made an enquiry about the price of the tickets.

enterprise.en: He started a small enterprise with two friends.
enterprise.zh: 他和两个朋友创办了一家小企业。

entertainment.en: The party was full of music and entertainment.
entertainment.zh: 聚会充满了音乐和娱乐。

enthusiastic.en: The students were enthusiastic about the school trip.
enthusiastic.zh: 学生们对学校旅行很热情。

environment.en: We should do more to protect the environment.
environment.zh: 我们应该做更多事情来保护环境。

eraser.en: May I borrow your eraser for a moment?
eraser.zh: 我可以借你的橡皮用一下吗？

evaluate.en: Teachers evaluate our work at the end of term.
evaluate.zh: 老师在学期末评价我们的作业。

evolution.en: The book explains the evolution of human language.
evolution.zh: 这本书解释了人类语言的演变。

excite.en: The good news excited the whole class.
excite.zh: 这个好消息使全班都很兴奋。

expand.en: The company plans to expand its business overseas.
expand.zh: 公司计划把业务扩展到海外。

expense.en: The trip was a big expense for the family.
expense.zh: 这次旅行对这家人是一笔很大的支出。

explicit.en: The teacher gave explicit instructions before the test.
explicit.zh: 考试前老师给出了清楚明白的指示。

exploit.en: The country began to exploit its rich oil fields.
exploit.zh: 这个国家开始开发其丰富的油田。

explore.en: They went to explore the old forest near the village.
explore.zh: 他们去探索村子附近的古老森林。

expose.en: The newspaper exposed the truth about the polluted river.
expose.zh: 报纸揭露了这条受污染河流的真相。

eyewitness.en: An eyewitness described the accident to the police.
eyewitness.zh: 一位目击者向警方描述了那起事故。

facial.en: A facial expression can show how you feel.
facial.zh: 面部表情能显示出你的感受。

fade.en: The red curtains have faded in the strong sun.
fade.zh: 红色的窗帘在强烈的阳光下褪色了。

fairness.en: Fairness is important when we play games together.
fairness.zh: 我们一起玩游戏时，公平很重要。

family name.en: Please write your family name in this box.
family name.zh: 请在这个方框里写上你的姓。

favour.en: Could you do me a favour after class?
favour.zh: 下课后你能帮我一个忙吗？

favourite.en: My favourite subject at school is history.
favourite.zh: 我在学校最喜欢的科目是历史。

feast.en: The villagers prepared a big feast for the festival.
feast.zh: 村民们为节日准备了一顿丰盛的宴席。

federa.en: The federal government gave money to build the road.
federa.zh: 联邦政府拨款修建这条路。

ferry.en: We took the ferry across the river to the island.
ferry.zh: 我们乘渡船过河去岛上。

fetch.en: Could you fetch me a glass of water?
fetch.zh: 你能给我拿一杯水来吗？

fibre.en: Vegetables and fruit are rich in fibre.

fierce.en: The fierce wind blew all night long.

fighter.en: The fighter was very brave in the battle.
fighter.zh: 那位战士在战斗中非常勇敢。

finance.en: He works in finance at a big bank.
finance.zh: 他在一家大银行做财务工作。

firefighter.en: The firefighter saved a child from the fire.
firefighter.zh: 那名消防员从火中救出了一个孩子。

fitting room.en: The fitting room is at the back of the shop.

flaming.en: We watched the flaming sun sink in the west.
flaming.zh: 我们看着火红的太阳从西方落下。

flee.en: The thief tried to flee when he saw the police.
flee.zh: 小偷看到警察就想逃走。

flexible.en: Our plan is flexible and easy to change.
flexible.zh: 我们的计划很灵活，容易改动。

flesh.en: The flesh of this fruit is soft and sweet.
flesh.zh: 这种水果的果肉又软又甜。

forbid.en: My parents forbid me to stay out late.
forbid.zh: 父母不许我在外面待到很晚。

foresee.en: Nobody could foresee what would happen next.
foresee.zh: 没人能预见接下来会发生什么。

format.en: They changed the format of the school show.
format.zh: 他们改变了学校演出的安排。

fortnight.en: We stayed by the sea for a fortnight.
fortnight.zh: 我们在海边待了两个星期。

founding.en: The founding of the school was in 1950.

franc.en: He paid five francs for the old book.
franc.zh: 他花五法郎买了这本旧书。

fragile.en: Be careful with that glass; it is fragile.
fragile.zh: 小心那个玻璃杯，它很易碎。

fragrant.en: The garden is full of fragrant flowers.
fragrant.zh: 花园里满是芬芳的花朵。

freeway.en: The freeway was busy with cars and trucks.
freeway.zh: 高速公路上满是汽车和卡车。

frenchman.en: A Frenchman taught us how to make bread.
frenchman.zh: 一位法国人教我们做面包。

friction.en: Friction makes it hard to move the box.
friction.zh: 摩擦使这个箱子难以移动。

frontier.en: They reached the frontier at sunset.
frontier.zh: 他们在日落时到达了边界。

fruit juice.en: I drink a glass of fruit juice every morning.
fruit juice.zh: 我每天早上喝一杯果汁。

function.en: This small button has an important function.
function.zh: 这个小按钮有重要的功能。

gale.en: A strong gale blew down the old tree.
gale.zh: 一阵强风把那棵老树吹倒了。

gallery.en: We saw many famous paintings in the gallery.
gallery.zh: 我们在画廊里看到许多名画。

garment.en: She washed every garment in warm water.
garment.zh: 她用温水洗了每件衣服。

geometry.en: Geometry is my favourite subject at school.
geometry.zh: 几何是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

gesture.en: He made a gesture to ask us to sit.
gesture.zh: 他做了个手势让我们坐下。

get--together.en: Our class had a get-together last Friday.
get--together.zh: 我们班上周五举行了一次聚会。

glance.en: She gave me a quick glance and smiled.
glance.zh: 她匆匆看了我一眼，笑了。

glare.en: The teacher glared at the noisy boys.
glare.zh: 老师怒视着那些吵闹的男孩。

glasshouse.en: The plants grow well in the glasshouse.
glasshouse.zh: 这些植物在温室里长得很好。

glory.en: The team won glory for our school.
glory.zh: 这支队伍为我们学校赢得了荣誉。

glove.en: He lost one glove on the way home.
glove.zh: 他在回家路上丢了一只手套。

goat.en: The goat is eating grass on the hill.

goldfish.en: Amy has two goldfish in a small bowl.
goldfish.zh: 艾米在一个小碗里养了两条金鱼。

good-bye.en: She waved good-bye and got on the bus.
good-bye.zh: 她挥手告别，上了公共汽车。

goodness.en: Her goodness made everyone love her.
goodness.zh: 她的善良让大家都喜欢她。

gown.en: Mary wore a long white gown to the party.
gown.zh: 玛丽穿着一条白色长礼服去参加聚会。

gradually.en: The weather gradually got warmer in April.

graduation.en: We took many photos at her graduation.
graduation.zh: 我们在她的毕业典礼上拍了很多照片。

gram.en: This apple weighs about two hundred grams.
gram.zh: 这个苹果大约重两百克。

grandchild.en: Their youngest grandchild is only three years old.
grandchild.zh: 他们最小的孙辈只有三岁。

granddaughter.en: Mary's granddaughter is learning to play the piano.
granddaughter.zh: 玛丽的孙女正在学弹钢琴。

granny.en: Granny tells us a story every night.
granny.zh: 奶奶每天晚上给我们讲一个故事。

grape.en: These grapes are sweet and full of juice.

graph.en: The graph shows how the price changed.
graph.zh: 这张图表显示了价格的变化。

greengrocer.en: The greengrocer sells fresh fruit and vegetables.
greengrocer.zh: 那个蔬菜水果商卖新鲜的水果和蔬菜。

grill.en: Put the meat on the grill for ten minutes.
grill.zh: 把肉放在烤架上烤十分钟。

grocer.en: The grocer gave me a bag of rice.
grocer.zh: 食品店老板给了我一袋米。

gruel.en: The poor child ate only gruel for supper.
gruel.zh: 那个可怜的孩子晚饭只喝了粥。

guidance.en: With his guidance, I finished the work.
guidance.zh: 在他的指导下，我完成了工作。

gymnastics.en: She does gymnastics after school every day.

ha.en: Ha! I found your key under the chair.
ha.zh: 哈！我在椅子下面找到了你的钥匙。

handtruck.en: He moved the boxes with a handtruck.
handtruck.zh: 他用手推运货车搬箱子。

hardship.en: The old man lived through great hardship.
hardship.zh: 那位老人经历了巨大的困难。

hardworking.en: Tom is a hardworking student in our class.
hardworking.zh: 汤姆是我们班一个勤奋的学生。

harmless.en: This little snake is harmless to people.

hatch.en: The hen is hatching her eggs in the box.

hay.en: The farmer gave the cows some dry hay.
hay.zh: 农民给奶牛喂了一些干草。

headline.en: The news made the front page headline.
headline.zh: 这条新闻成了头版大字标题。

headmaster.en: The headmaster spoke to us at the meeting.
headmaster.zh: 校长在会上对我们讲了话。

headmistress.en: The headmistress opened the new library today.
headmistress.zh: 女校长今天开放了新图书馆。

headteacher.en: Our headteacher is kind to every student.
headteacher.zh: 我们的班主任对每个学生都很和善。

heap.en: There is a heap of books on the desk.

herb.en: My mother grows herbs in the garden.
herb.zh: 我妈妈在花园里种草药。

hibernate.en: Some animals hibernate through the cold winter.
hibernate.zh: 有些动物整个寒冷的冬天都在冬眠。

hibernation.en: Bears go into hibernation in late autumn.

hide and seek.en: The children are playing hide and seek outside.
hide and seek.zh: 孩子们在外面玩捉迷藏。

hillside.en: Sheep were eating grass on the hillside.

hilly.en: This hilly area is cool in summer.
hilly.zh: 这个多小山的地区夏天很凉爽。

hive.en: The bees flew back to their hive.
hive.zh: 蜜蜂飞回了它们的蜂箱。

holy.en: This holy place is quiet and beautiful.
holy.zh: 这个神圣的地方安静而美丽。

homeland.en: He returned to his homeland after ten years.

hong kong.en: Hong Kong is a busy city in China.
hong kong.zh: 香港是中国一座繁忙的城市。

hooray.en: Hooray! Our team won the game today.
hooray.zh: 好哇！我们队今天赢了比赛。

host.en: Our host was very kind to all the guests.
host.zh: 我们的主人对所有客人都很热情。

hostess.en: The hostess brought us tea and cake.
hostess.zh: 女主人给我们端来了茶和蛋糕。

hot dog.en: I bought a hot dog and a drink.
hot dog.zh: 我买了一个热狗和一杯饮料。

housewife.en: The housewife gets up early every morning.
housewife.zh: 这位家庭主妇每天早上起得很早。

howl.en: The dog began to howl at midnight.

human being.en: Every human being needs food and water.
human being.zh: 每个人都需要食物和水。

humorous.en: Our English teacher is humorous and kind.
humorous.zh: 我们的英语老师幽默又和善。

hydrogen.en: Hydrogen is a very light gas.

ice--cream.en: The children ate ice cream in the park.
ice--cream.zh: 孩子们在公园里吃冰淇淋。

idiom.en: This idiom is hard for me to understand.
idiom.zh: 这个习语对我来说很难理解。

immigration.en: The immigration office was full of people.

information desk.en: Ask at the information desk for a map.

inland.en: They travelled to an inland town by train.
inland.zh: 他们坐火车去了一个内陆小镇。

insert.en: Please insert the card into the machine.

inspire.en: Her story inspired me to work harder.
inspire.zh: 她的故事激励我更努力地工作。

institute.en: She works at a research institute in Beijing.
institute.zh: 她在北京的一家研究所工作。

institution.en: The old institution helps many poor children.
institution.zh: 这所老机构帮助许多穷孩子。

instruct.en: The coach instructed us to run faster.
instruct.zh: 教练指示我们跑得更快。

insure.en: You should insure your house against fire.

interval.en: We had a short interval between classes.
interval.zh: 两节课之间我们有一段短暂的间歇。

introduction.en: His introduction of the new plan was clear.
introduction.zh: 他对新计划的介绍很清楚。

inventor.en: The inventor made a small useful machine.
inventor.zh: 这位发明者造了一台有用的小机器。

ireland.en: Ireland is a green island in Europe.
ireland.zh: 爱尔兰是欧洲一个绿色的岛国。

irish.en: He likes Irish music and Irish dancing.
irish.zh: 他喜欢爱尔兰音乐和爱尔兰舞蹈。

irrigate.en: Farmers irrigate their fields in the dry season.

irrigation.en: This area needs better irrigation for its crops.
irrigation.zh: 这个地区的庄稼需要更好的灌溉。

jewel.en: She wore a beautiful jewel on her finger.
jewel.zh: 她手指上戴着一颗美丽的宝石。

juicy.en: These oranges are sweet and very juicy.

junk mail.en: I throw most junk mail away at once.
junk mail.zh: 我马上把大部分广告宣传品扔掉。

junk food.en: Too much junk food is bad for you.
junk food.zh: 吃太多垃圾食品对你有害。

keeper.en: The keeper feeds the monkeys every morning.
keeper.zh: 饲养员每天早上喂猴子。

keyboard.en: He types quickly on the new keyboard.
keyboard.zh: 他在新键盘上打字很快。

kilometr.en: The school is two kilometres from my home.

kindergarten.en: My little brother goes to kindergarten every day.

kind-hearted.en: Our kind-hearted neighbour helped the old man cross the street.
kind-hearted.zh: 我们好心的邻居帮助那位老人过马路。

labourer.en: The labourer worked hard in the field all day.
labourer.zh: 那个体力劳动者在田里辛苦干了一整天。

lamb.en: The little lamb followed its mother across the grass.
lamb.zh: 小羊羔跟着妈妈走过草地。

lame.en: The lame dog walked slowly along the road.
lame.zh: 那只瘸腿的狗沿着路慢慢地走。

lantern.en: We hung a red lantern outside the front door.
lantern.zh: 我们在前门外挂了一盏红灯笼。

lap.en: The cat sat on the old woman's lap.
lap.zh: 那只猫坐在老妇人的膝上。

latter.en: Of the two choices, I prefer the latter.
latter.zh: 在这两个选择中，我更喜欢后者。

lavatory.en: The lavatory on this floor is very clean.

left-wing.en: He is a member of a left-wing party.
left-wing.zh: 他是一个左翼政党的成员。

lemonade.en: She drank a cold glass of lemonade after lunch.
lemonade.zh: 午饭后她喝了一杯冰柠檬水。

letter-box.en: I put the letter into the letter-box this morning.
letter-box.zh: 今天早上我把信投进了信箱。

liberty.en: All people should enjoy liberty and equal rights.
liberty.zh: 所有人都应享有自由和平等的权利。

liberate.en: The soldiers liberated the town from the enemy.
liberate.zh: 士兵们从敌人手中解放了这座城镇。

liberation.en: The whole city celebrated the liberation of the country.
liberation.zh: 全城都在庆祝国家的解放。

librarian.en: The librarian helped me find the book I needed.
librarian.zh: 图书管理员帮我找到了我需要的书。

literary.en: She is reading a famous literary work this term.
literary.zh: 这学期她在读一部著名的文学作品。

litter.en: Please do not litter in the park.
litter.zh: 请不要在公园里乱丢杂物。

locust.en: A swarm of locusts flew over the field.

loose.en: He wore a loose shirt and old jeans.
loose.zh: 他穿着一件宽松的衬衫和旧牛仔裤。

lorry.en: A heavy lorry stopped in front of our school.
lorry.zh: 一辆重型卡车停在我们学校前面。

loudspeaker.en: The teacher spoke to us through a loudspeaker.
loudspeaker.zh: 老师通过扬声器对我们讲话。

lounge.en: We waited for the train in the hotel lounge.
lounge.zh: 我们在旅馆的休息厅等火车。

magic.en: The old woman gave him a magic ring.
magic.zh: 老妇人给了他一个带魔力的戒指。

maid.en: A young maid brought us tea and cakes.
maid.zh: 一位年轻的女仆给我们端来了茶和蛋糕。

mainland.en: They moved from the island to the mainland.
mainland.zh: 他们从岛上搬到了大陆。

mankind.en: This discovery will help all mankind in the future.
mankind.zh: 这一发现将来会造福全人类。

man-made.en: This lake is man-made, not natural at all.
man-made.zh: 这个湖是人工的，根本不是天然的。

table manners.en: Good table manners are important at a dinner party.
table manners.zh: 在晚宴上，良好的餐桌礼节很重要。

maple leaves.en: The maple leaves turn red in autumn.

marble.en: The floor of the hall is made of marble.
marble.zh: 大厅的地面是用大理石做的。

maximum.en: The maximum temperature today was thirty degrees.
maximum.zh: 今天的最高气温是三十度。

may modal.en: You may leave the classroom after the test.
may modal.zh: 考试结束后你可以离开教室。

meanwhile.en: Amy cooked dinner and meanwhile Tom cleaned the room.
meanwhile.zh: 艾米做晚饭，与此同时汤姆打扫房间。

medal.en: She won a medal in the running race.
medal.zh: 她在赛跑中赢得了一枚奖牌。

gold medal.en: He won the gold medal for swimming last year.
gold medal.zh: 去年他获得了游泳金牌。

media.en: The media reported the news all over the world.
media.zh: 媒体在全世界报道了这条新闻。

medium.en: My father is a man of medium height.
medium.zh: 我父亲是个中等身材的人。

memorial.en: We visited the memorial to the war heroes.
memorial.zh: 我们参观了战争英雄纪念馆。

memorize.en: Students must memorize these new words by Friday.
memorize.zh: 学生们必须在周五前记住这些新单词。

merchant.en: The merchant sold silk and tea in the old town.
merchant.zh: 那位商人在老城里卖丝绸和茶叶。

merciful.en: The king was merciful and freed the prisoner.
merciful.zh: 国王很仁慈，释放了那个囚犯。

messy.en: His bedroom is always messy and full of clothes.
messy.zh: 他的卧室总是乱七八糟，堆满了衣服。

microcomputer.en: Our school bought ten microcomputers for the lab.
microcomputer.zh: 我们学校为实验室买了十台微机。

mid-autumn.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a time for family.
mid-autumn.zh: 中秋节是家人团聚的时候。

midday.en: We stopped for lunch at midday.
midday.zh: 中午我们停下来吃午饭。

middle east.en: Many countries in the Middle East export oil.
middle east.zh: 中东许多国家出口石油。

minibus.en: A small minibus took us to the village.
minibus.zh: 一辆小型公共汽车把我们送到了村里。

ministry.en: The Ministry of Education announced a new plan.
ministry.zh: 教育部宣布了一项新计划。

minority.en: Only a small minority of students disagreed.

missile.en: The missile flew high over the sea.
missile.zh: 导弹在海面上空高高飞过。

mobile phone.en: My mobile phone is out of power.

modem.en: He connected the modem to the computer.
modem.zh: 他把调制解调器连到了电脑上。

monitor.en: Tom is our class monitor this year.
monitor.zh: 今年汤姆是我们班的班长。

monument.en: They built a monument in the city centre.
monument.zh: 他们在市中心建了一座纪念碑。

moon cake.en: Mary gave me a sweet moon cake.
moon cake.zh: 玛丽给了我一块甜甜的月饼。

moral.en: The story has a clear moral for children.
moral.zh: 这个故事对孩子有明确的寓意。

moscow.en: Moscow is the capital city of Russia.
moscow.zh: 莫斯科是俄罗斯的首都。

moslem.en: My Moslem friend never eats pork.
moslem.zh: 我的伊斯兰教朋友从不吃猪肉。

motherland.en: He returned to his motherland after many years.
motherland.zh: 多年以后他回到了祖国。

motivation.en: Her motivation for studying hard is very strong.
motivation.zh: 她努力学习的动机很强。

motor.en: The motor of the old car stopped working.
motor.zh: 那辆旧车的发动机不转了。

motorbike.en: He rides his motorbike to work every day.

motto.en: Our team motto is never give up.
motto.zh: 我们队的格言是永不放弃。

moustache.en: My uncle has a thick black moustache.
moustache.zh: 我叔叔留着浓密的黑胡子。

mouthful.en: She took a mouthful of hot soup.

from mouth to mouth.en: The good news spread from mouth to mouth.

movement.en: She joined a movement to protect wild animals.
movement.zh: 她参加了一个保护野生动物的运动。

muddy.en: My shoes got muddy on the wet path.
muddy.zh: 我的鞋在湿漉漉的小路上沾满了泥。

multiply.en: Multiply seven by eight and you get fifty-six.

mushroom.en: We picked fresh mushrooms in the forest.
mushroom.zh: 我们在森林里采了新鲜蘑菇。

must modal.en: You must finish your homework before dinner.
must modal.zh: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。

mustard.en: He put some mustard on his sandwich.
mustard.zh: 他在三明治上放了些芥末。

mutton.en: My grandmother cooked mutton with potatoes.
mutton.zh: 我奶奶炖了羊肉和土豆。

nationality.en: Please write your name and nationality here.
nationality.zh: 请在这里写下你的姓名和国籍。

nationwide.en: The new law was announced nationwide last week.
nationwide.zh: 新法律上周在全国范围内公布。

negotiate.en: The two sides will negotiate a new contract.
negotiate.zh: 双方将协商一份新合同。

new york.en: My cousin lives in New York now.

new zealand.en: New Zealand is famous for its green hills.

new zealander.en: A New Zealander taught us English last year.
new zealander.zh: 一位新西兰人去年教我们英语。

niece.en: My niece is only five years old.

night-club.en: They danced at a night-club until midnight.
night-club.zh: 他们在一家夜总会跳舞到午夜。

nineteen.en: My brother is nineteen years old this year.

ninth.en: She lives on the ninth floor of that building.

noble.en: He came from a noble family in the north.
noble.zh: 他出身于北方的一个贵族家庭。

noisily.en: The children ran noisily down the stairs.
noisily.zh: 孩子们吵吵闹闹地跑下楼梯。

non-stop.en: We flew non-stop from Beijing to London.

non-violent.en: They chose a non-violent way to solve the problem.
non-violent.zh: 他们选择了非暴力的方式来解决问题。

noodle.en: I had a bowl of noodles for lunch.

northeast.en: The wind comes from the northeast in winter.
northeast.zh: 冬天风从东北方向吹来。

northwards.en: The birds flew northwards at the end of March.

november.en: It gets cold here in November.

nursing.en: My sister is studying nursing at college.

nutrition.en: Good nutrition is important for growing children.
nutrition.zh: 良好的营养对成长中的孩子很重要。

nylon.en: This bag is made of strong nylon.
nylon.zh: 这个包是用结实的尼龙做的。

offence.en: Driving without a licence is a serious offence.
offence.zh: 无证驾驶是严重的违法行为。

offshore.en: They found oil in the offshore area.
offshore.zh: 他们在近海地区发现了石油。

oilfield.en: My uncle works in a large oilfield.
oilfield.zh: 我叔叔在一个大油田工作。

olympic games.en: The Olympic Games take place every four years.
olympic games.zh: 奥运会每四年举行一次。

omelette.en: Amy made a cheese omelette for breakfast.
omelette.zh: 艾米早餐做了一个奶酪煎蛋卷。

opener.en: I cannot find the bottle opener anywhere.
opener.zh: 我到处都找不到开瓶器。

opera house.en: We saw a show at the new opera house.
opera house.zh: 我们在新歌剧院看了一场演出。

oppose.en: Most parents oppose the plan to close the school.
oppose.zh: 大多数家长反对关闭学校的计划。

optional.en: This course is optional for first-year students.
optional.zh: 这门课对一年级学生是选修的。

oral.en: We have an oral test in English tomorrow.

organiser.en: The organiser of the concert thanked all the helpers.
organiser.zh: 音乐会的组织者感谢了所有的帮手。

ottawa.en: Ottawa is the capital city of Canada.
ottawa.zh: 渥太华是加拿大的首都。

outcome.en: Nobody knows the outcome of the game yet.
outcome.zh: 还没有人知道比赛的结果。

outer.en: The outer walls of the house need paint.

outgoing.en: Amy is outgoing and makes friends easily.
outgoing.zh: 艾米很外向，很容易交到朋友。

outing.en: Our class went on an outing to the hills.

output.en: The factory increased its output last year.
output.zh: 这家工厂去年提高了产量。

outspoken.en: Amy is outspoken and always says what she thinks.
outspoken.zh: 艾米很直率，总是想什么就说什么。

outstanding.en: She is an outstanding student in our class.
outstanding.zh: 她是我们班一名优秀的学生。

outward.en: The door opens outward, not inward.
outward.zh: 这扇门向外开，不是向内开。

oval.en: The table in the kitchen is oval.
oval.zh: 厨房里的那张桌子是椭圆形的。

ownership.en: The ownership of the land is still unclear.
ownership.zh: 这块土地的所有权仍不清楚。

the pacific ocean.en: We crossed the Pacific Ocean by ship last year.
the pacific ocean.zh: 去年我们乘船横渡了太平洋。

packet.en: He bought a packet of biscuits for tea.
packet.zh: 他买了一包饼干当茶点。

paddle.en: He lost his paddle in the river.

palace.en: The old palace is open to visitors.
palace.zh: 这座古老的宫殿对游客开放。

pancake.en: My mother makes pancakes for us on Sundays.
pancake.zh: 我妈妈每到周日就给我们做薄煎饼。

panda.en: The panda is eating bamboo in the zoo.
panda.zh: 动物园里的熊猫正在吃竹子。

paperwork.en: I have too much paperwork to do today.
paperwork.zh: 我今天有太多文书工作要做。

passer-by.en: A passer-by helped the old man cross the road.
passer-by.zh: 一位过路人帮助那位老人过了马路。

patent.en: Tom got a patent for his new machine.
patent.zh: 汤姆为他的新机器拿到了专利。

pause.en: She paused for a moment before answering.
pause.zh: 她回答前停顿了一会儿。

peasant.en: The peasant works hard in the fields every day.
peasant.zh: 那个农民每天在田里辛勤劳作。

pedestrian.en: A pedestrian was waiting at the crossing.
pedestrian.zh: 一位行人在人行横道处等着。

pencil-box.en: My pencil-box is full of pens and rulers.
pencil-box.zh: 我的铅笔盒里装满了笔和尺子。

pen-friend.en: I write to my pen-friend in Canada every month.
pen-friend.zh: 我每个月给在加拿大的笔友写信。

pension.en: My grandfather lives on a small pension.
pension.zh: 我祖父靠一份微薄的养老金生活。

percentage.en: A large percentage of students walk to school.
percentage.zh: 很大比例的学生步行上学。

performer.en: The young performer sang beautifully on the stage.
performer.zh: 那位年轻的表演者在台上唱得很动听。

perfume.en: She wears a light perfume in summer.
perfume.zh: 她夏天用一款淡淡的香水。

personnel.en: The company hired new personnel last month.
personnel.zh: 公司上个月招了新职员。

pest.en: Farmers use special ways to kill pests.
pest.zh: 农民用特别的方法消灭害虫。

petrol.en: The car stopped because it had no petrol.
petrol.zh: 那辆车因为没汽油而停了下来。

phone-booth.en: There is a phone-booth near the station.
phone-booth.zh: 车站附近有一个公用电话间。

physicist.en: My uncle is a famous physicist.
physicist.zh: 我叔叔是一位著名的物理学家。

pile.en: There is a pile of books on the desk.

pill.en: Take one pill twice a day after meals.
pill.zh: 这种药每天饭后吃一片，一日两次。

ping-pong.en: We play ping-pong after school every Friday.
ping-pong.zh: 我们每周五放学后打乒乓球。

pioneer.en: He was a pioneer in computer science.
pioneer.zh: 他是计算机科学领域的开拓者。

platform.en: The train to Beijing leaves from platform six.
platform.zh: 开往北京的火车从六号站台出发。

playroom.en: The children are playing in the playroom.
playroom.zh: 孩子们正在游戏室里玩。

playmate.en: Mary found a new playmate in the park.
playmate.zh: 玛丽在公园里找到了一个新玩伴。

plug.en: He pulled the plug out of the bath.
plug.zh: 他把浴缸的塞子拔了下来。

pole.en: A flag is flying at the top of the pole.

the north.en: Few people can live at the North Pole.
the north.zh: 很少有人能在北极生活。

pollute.en: Factories should not pollute the river.
pollute.zh: 工厂不应该污染这条河。

porridge.en: I eat porridge with eggs for breakfast.

portable.en: This portable radio is easy to carry.
portable.zh: 这台便携式收音机很容易携带。

porter.en: A porter carried our bags to the room.
porter.zh: 一位搬运工把我们的包搬到了房间。

postage.en: The postage for this letter is two yuan.

postbox.en: Tom put the letter into the red postbox.
postbox.zh: 汤姆把信投进了那个红色的邮箱。

postcode.en: Please write your postcode on the envelope.
postcode.zh: 请在信封上写下你的邮政编码。

postman.en: The postman brings letters to our street every morning.
postman.zh: 邮递员每天早上给我们这条街送信。

postpone.en: They postponed the match because of the rain.
postpone.zh: 因为下雨，他们把比赛推迟了。

praise.en: The teacher praised Amy for her hard work.
praise.zh: 老师表扬了艾米的努力。

prayer.en: She said a short prayer before the meal.
prayer.zh: 吃饭前她做了一个简短的祈祷。

preference.en: I have a preference for green tea.

premier.en: The premier visited the school last week.
premier.zh: 总理上周访问了这所学校。

presentation.en: Tom gave a short presentation about pandas.
presentation.zh: 汤姆做了一个关于熊猫的简短演示。

preview.en: Please preview the new lesson before class.

primary school.en: My little sister goes to primary school nearby.
primary school.zh: 我妹妹在附近的小学上学。

primitive.en: People in primitive times lived in caves.
primitive.zh: 原始时代的人住在洞穴里。

principle.en: He is a man of strong moral principles.
principle.zh: 他是一个很有道德原则的人。

probable.en: It is probable that it will rain tomorrow.

produce.en: This factory produces cars for many countries.
produce.zh: 这家工厂为许多国家生产汽车。

promote.en: The company promoted Tom to manager.
promote.zh: 公司把汤姆提升为经理。

province.en: My hometown is in the south of this province.
province.zh: 我的家乡在这个省的南部。

psychology.en: She studies psychology at the university.

publicly.en: He apologized publicly for his mistake.
publicly.zh: 他公开为自己的错误道歉。

punctuate.zh: 请给这个句子正确加标点。

pupil.en: Every pupil in the class has a new book.
pupil.zh: 班上每个学生都有一本新书。

pyramid.en: We saw the great pyramids in Egypt.
pyramid.zh: 我们在埃及看到了宏伟的金字塔。

quake.en: The ground quaked for a few seconds.

qualification.en: She has the right qualifications for this job.
qualification.zh: 她具备这份工作所需的资格。

questionnaire.en: Please fill in this questionnaire about your habits.
questionnaire.zh: 请填写这份关于你习惯的调查问卷。

queue.en: There was a long queue at the bus stop.

radioactive.en: This radioactive waste is dangerous to people.
radioactive.zh: 这种放射性废料对人有害。

rag.en: He cleaned the window with an old rag.
rag.zh: 他用一块旧抹布擦了窗户。

rail.en: Traveling by rail is cheap and comfortable.
rail.zh: 乘火车旅行既便宜又舒适。

random.en: He picked a random number from one to ten.
random.zh: 他从一到十中随便挑了一个数字。

rank.en: He reached the rank of captain in the army.
rank.zh: 他在军队里升到了上尉军衔。

raw material.en: Wood is the raw material for paper.

razor.en: My father shaves with a razor every morning.
razor.zh: 我父亲每天早上用剃须刀刮胡子。

receiver.en: She put down the receiver and smiled.

reception.en: We got a warm reception at the school.
reception.zh: 我们在学校受到了热情的接待。

receptionist.en: The receptionist asked us to wait a moment.
receptionist.zh: 接待员让我们稍等一下。

recipe.en: My mother gave me her soup recipe.
recipe.zh: 妈妈把她那道汤的食谱给了我。

record holder.en: Tom is the record holder for the long jump.
record holder.zh: 汤姆是跳远纪录保持者。

recreation.en: Reading is a good form of recreation.
recreation.zh: 阅读是一种很好的消遣方式。

recycle.en: We recycle paper and bottles at school.
recycle.zh: 我们在学校回收纸张和瓶子。

rectangle.en: The garden has the shape of a rectangle.

redirect.en: The sign redirected us to another road.
redirect.zh: 那块路牌把我们引向了另一条路。

referee.en: The referee blew his whistle and stopped the game.
referee.zh: 裁判吹响哨子，中止了比赛。

reference.en: He made a short reference to the new plan.
reference.zh: 他简略地提到了那个新计划。

reflect.en: The lake reflects the blue sky and white clouds.
reflect.zh: 湖面倒映着蓝天和白云。

regardless.en: He went out regardless of the heavy rain.
regardless.zh: 他不顾大雨，还是出门了。

regulation.en: All students must follow the school regulations.
regulation.zh: 所有学生都必须遵守校规。

relate.en: This question relates to our last lesson.
relate.zh: 这个问题与我们上一节课有关。

relation.en: There is a close relation between diet and health.
relation.zh: 饮食和健康之间有密切的关系。

relay.en: Our team won the relay race yesterday.
relay.zh: 我们队昨天赢得了接力赛。

resemble.en: Amy resembles her mother very much.

restrict.en: The school restricts the use of phones.

restriction.en: The new rules put restrictions on parking.
restriction.zh: 新规定对停车做出了限制。

retell.en: Please retell the story in your own words.
retell.zh: 请用你自己的话复述这个故事。

reuse.en: We can reuse these boxes many times.
reuse.zh: 这些盒子我们可以重复使用很多次。

reviewer.en: The reviewer liked the book very much.
reviewer.zh: 那位评论者非常喜欢这本书。

revision.en: I need two days for revision before the exam.
revision.zh: 考试前我需要两天时间复习。

rewind.en: Please rewind the tape after you finish it.
rewind.zh: 用完磁带后请把它倒回去。

riddle.en: Nobody could answer the riddle in class.
riddle.zh: 课上没有人能猜出这个谜语。

right-wing.en: The right-wing party won fewer seats this time.
right-wing.zh: 右翼政党这次赢得的席位更少。

ring-road.en: The ring-road around the city is very busy.
ring-road.zh: 环绕城市的环形公路非常繁忙。

rigid.en: His rigid ideas made the talk difficult.
rigid.zh: 他死板的想法让谈话变得困难。

ripen.en: The apples ripen in late summer.

roller skatingn.en: Amy goes roller skating every Sunday morning.
roller skatingn.zh: 艾米每周日早上都去滑旱冰。

rooster.en: The rooster wakes us up every morning.
rooster.zh: 公鸡每天早上把我们叫醒。

rot.en: The old apples began to rot in the box.
rot.zh: 那些旧苹果在箱子里开始腐烂。

roundabout.en: We drove around the roundabout and turned left.
roundabout.zh: 我们绕过转盘路，然后向左转。

routine.en: Reading before bed is part of my daily routine.
routine.zh: 睡前阅读是我日常惯例的一部分。

royal.en: The royal family lives in that big palace.
royal.zh: 王室成员住在那座大宫殿里。

rubber.en: These boots are made of soft rubber.
rubber.zh: 这双靴子是用软橡胶做的。

sacred.en: This old temple is a sacred place for us.
sacred.zh: 这座古庙对我们来说是神圣的地方。

sailor.en: The sailor tied the boat to the dock.

salesgirl.en: The salesgirl helped me find a warm coat.
salesgirl.zh: 女售货员帮我找到一件暖和的外套。

saleswoman.en: The saleswoman showed us three different bags.
saleswoman.zh: 女售货员给我们看了三个不同的包。

salute.en: The soldiers salute the flag every morning.
salute.zh: 士兵们每天早上向国旗敬礼。

satisfaction.en: She smiled with satisfaction at her good grades.
satisfaction.zh: 她对自己的好成绩满意地笑了。

saucer.en: He put the cup back on the saucer.

savage.en: The story is about a savage in the forest.
savage.zh: 这个故事讲的是森林里的一个野蛮人。

scan.en: I scanned the page for my name.
scan.zh: 我快速浏览页面寻找我的名字。

sceptical.en: Tom is sceptical about that strange story.
sceptical.zh: 汤姆对那个奇怪的故事持怀疑态度。

schoolbag.en: My schoolbag is too heavy to carry.
schoolbag.zh: 我的书包太重了，拿不动。

school-leaver.en: As a school-leaver, Amy is looking for work.
school-leaver.zh: 作为学校毕业生，艾米正在找工作。

schoolmate.en: Mary met an old schoolmate at the station.
schoolmate.zh: 玛丽在车站遇到了一位老同学。

scottish.en: My Scottish friend sings beautiful old songs.
scottish.zh: 我的苏格兰朋友会唱好听的老歌。

sculpture.en: The museum shows a famous sculpture of a horse.
sculpture.zh: 博物馆展出一件著名的马的雕塑。

seagull.en: A seagull flew low over the quiet sea.
seagull.zh: 一只海鸥在平静的海面上低飞。

seal.en: A seal lay on the ice and slept.
seal.zh: 一只海豹躺在冰上睡觉。

seaman.en: The old seaman told us many sea stories.
seaman.zh: 老海员给我们讲了许多海上故事。

seaweed.en: Green seaweed was floating near the rocks.
seaweed.zh: 绿色的海草在岩石附近漂浮。

secure.en: She felt secure with her family around her.
secure.zh: 有家人在身边，她感到很安心。

melon seed.en: We ate melon seeds while watching the film.
melon seed.zh: 我们一边看电影一边嗑瓜子。

see-saw.en: The children played on the see-saw happily.
see-saw.zh: 孩子们开心地玩跷跷板。

seize.en: He seized the chance to speak to her.

self.en: After a long rest, she felt like her old self.
self.zh: 休息了很久之后，她感觉又像原来的自己了。

semicircle.en: The students sat in a semicircle on the floor.
semicircle.zh: 学生们在地板上坐成半圆形。

separation.en: The separation from her family made her sad.
separation.zh: 与家人分离让她很难过。

service-charge.en: The bill includes a small service charge.
service-charge.zh: 账单里包含一小笔服务费。

session.en: Our first training session lasts two hours.
session.zh: 我们的第一节训练课持续两个小时。

settle.en: They decided to settle in a small town.
settle.zh: 他们决定在一个小镇上定居。

settler.en: The first settlers built homes near the river.
settler.zh: 最早的移居者在河边建起了家园。

seventh.en: Tom lives on the seventh floor of that building.
seventh.zh: 汤姆住在那栋楼的七层。

sex.en: Please write your name, age and sex here.
sex.zh: 请在这里写下你的姓名、年龄和性别。

shallow.en: The water here is shallow and warm.

sharpen.en: He used a stone to sharpen his knife.
sharpen.zh: 他用一块石头把刀磨快。

sharpener.en: May I borrow your pencil sharpener for a moment?
sharpener.zh: 我能借用一下你的卷笔刀吗？

pencil- sharpener.en: I bought a new pencil-sharpener for school.
pencil- sharpener.zh: 我为上学买了一个新转笔刀。

shop assistant.en: The shop assistant wrapped the gift for me.
shop assistant.zh: 售货员帮我把礼物包好了。

shopkeeper.en: The shopkeeper gave the child a free apple.
shopkeeper.zh: 店主给了那个孩子一个免费的苹果。

shortcoming.en: Everyone has shortcomings, and so do you.
shortcoming.zh: 每个人都有缺点，你也是。

shorts.en: He wears shorts when he plays basketball.

short wave.en: My radio can pick up short wave signals.
short wave.zh: 我的收音机能收到短波信号。

shrink.en: Wool sweaters may shrink in hot water.
shrink.zh: 羊毛衫在热水里可能会缩水。

shuttle.en: A free shuttle takes visitors to the museum.
shuttle.zh: 有免费班车送游客去博物馆。

shyv.en: The shy girl said nothing at the party.
shyv.zh: 那个害羞的女孩在聚会上什么也没说。

sideway.en: We took a sideway to avoid the busy road.
sideway.zh: 我们走了一条岔路以避开繁忙的马路。

sideways.en: He turned sideways to let me pass.

sightseeing.en: We spent the whole day sightseeing in the city.
sightseeing.zh: 我们花了一整天在城里观光。

silk.en: This red dress is made of pure silk.
silk.zh: 这条红裙子是纯丝绸做的。

simple-minded.en: He is simple-minded but kind to everyone.
simple-minded.zh: 他头脑简单，但对每个人都很友善。

simplify.en: The teacher simplified the story for young readers.
simplify.zh: 老师为小读者简化了这个故事。

sincerely.en: I sincerely hope you will come back soon.
sincerely.zh: 我真诚地希望你能很快回来。

sister-in-law.zh: 我嫂子做的面条很好吃。

sixth.en: Our classroom is on the sixth floor.

sixteenth.en: Her birthday is on the sixteenth of May.
sixteenth.zh: 她的生日是五月十六日。

skillful.en: He is a skillful cook and makes great soup.
skillful.zh: 他是个熟练的厨师，做的汤很好喝。

skillfully.en: She skillfully cut the paper into small stars.
skillfully.zh: 她巧妙地把纸剪成小星星。

skipping.en: Amy brought her skipping rope to the park.
skipping.zh: 艾米把她的跳绳带到了公园。

skyscraper.en: A new skyscraper stands beside the river.
skyscraper.zh: 一座新的摩天楼矗立在河边。

slide.en: The children love the long slide in the park.
slide.zh: 孩子们喜欢公园里那条长长的滑道。

slim.en: She looks slim and healthy in that dress.
slim.zh: 她穿那条裙子显得苗条又健康。

smelly.en: The smelly fish was thrown away at once.
smelly.zh: 那条发臭的鱼立刻被扔掉了。

smog.en: Thick smog covered the city for three days.
smog.zh: 浓重的烟雾笼罩了这座城市三天。

smoke-free.en: This restaurant is a smoke-free place for families.
smoke-free.zh: 这家餐馆是适合家庭的无烟场所。

snack bar.en: We had lunch at a small snack bar.
snack bar.zh: 我们在一家小快餐店吃了午饭。

snatch.en: A thief snatched her bag and ran away.
snatch.zh: 一个贼抢走了她的包跑掉了。

sneaker.en: My new sneakers are light and comfortable.
sneaker.zh: 我的新运动鞋又轻又舒服。

sniff.en: The boy sniffed because he had a cold.
sniff.zh: 那个男孩因为感冒而抽鼻子。

snowball.en: The children threw a big snowball at Tom.
snowball.zh: 孩子们朝汤姆扔了一个大雪球。

snowy.en: We walked home on a cold snowy night.
snowy.zh: 我们在一个寒冷的下雪夜晚走回家。

socialism.en: He studied socialism in his history class.
socialism.zh: 他在历史课上学习社会主义。

socialist.en: They built a socialist country with hard work.
socialist.zh: 他们用辛勤劳动建设了一个社会主义国家。

socket.en: Please put the plug into the socket.

soft drink.en: I would like a cold soft drink.
soft drink.zh: 我想要一杯冰镇清凉饮料。

softball.en: Our class won the softball game yesterday.
softball.zh: 我们班昨天赢了垒球比赛。

so-so.en: The film was so-so, not really exciting.
so-so.zh: 这部电影一般，并不怎么精彩。

southeast.en: The wind comes from the southeast in spring.

southern.en: Winter is short in the southern part of China.

southwest.en: The small town lies in the southwest of the country.
southwest.zh: 这个小镇位于该国的西南部。

spaceship.en: The spaceship flew far into space.
spaceship.zh: 宇宙飞船飞向太空深处。

spade.en: He dug the garden with a small spade.
spade.zh: 他用一把小铲子挖园子。

spaghettiv.en: We ate spaghetti with tomato sauce for dinner.
spaghettiv.zh: 我们晚饭吃了番茄酱意大利面。

sparrow.en: A sparrow landed on the windowsill and sang.
sparrow.zh: 一只麻雀落在窗台上唱歌。

specialist.en: The doctor sent him to a heart specialist.
specialist.zh: 医生把他转给一位心脏专家。

specific.en: Please give me a specific answer to my question.
specific.zh: 请就我的问题给我一个明确的答复。

spiritual.en: Music brings her great spiritual comfort.
spiritual.zh: 音乐给她带来很大的精神安慰。

splendid.en: We had a splendid time at the beach.
splendid.zh: 我们在海滩上玩得非常开心。

sponsor.en: The company is the main sponsor of the team.
sponsor.zh: 这家公司是该队的主要赞助商。

spoonful.en: Add two spoonfuls of sugar to the milk.

squeeze.en: She gave my hand a gentle squeeze.
squeeze.zh: 她轻轻捏了一下我的手。

squid.en: We had fried squid for lunch today.
squid.zh: 我们今天午饭吃了炸鱿鱼。

squirrel.en: A squirrel ran up the tall tree.
squirrel.zh: 一只松鼠跑上了那棵高树。

stable.en: The old bridge is still strong and stable.
stable.zh: 这座老桥依然坚固稳固。

stainless.en: The stainless steel pot is easy to clean.
stainless.zh: 这个不锈钢锅很容易清洗。

stainless steel.en: Our new kitchen table is made of stainless steel.
stainless steel.zh: 我们的新餐桌是不锈钢做的。

status.en: Her status as a doctor brings her much respect.
status.zh: 她作为医生的身份为她带来很多尊重。

steel.en: The bridge is built of strong steel.
steel.zh: 这座桥是用坚固的钢建成的。

step-mother.en: His step-mother treats him with great kindness.
step-mother.zh: 他的继母对他非常和善。

steward.en: The steward brought us hot tea and towels.
steward.zh: 男乘务员给我们送来了热茶和毛巾。

stopwatch.en: The coach timed each runner with a stopwatch.
stopwatch.zh: 教练用跑表为每位跑步者计时。

storage.en: We keep old books in the storage room.
storage.zh: 我们把旧书存放在储藏室里。

stout.en: The stout old horse pulled the heavy cart.
stout.zh: 那匹肥壮的老马拉着沉重的车。

strait.en: The ship sailed through the narrow strait.
strait.zh: 那艘船驶过狭窄的海峡。

straw.en: The farmer put dry straw under the cows.
straw.zh: 农民在奶牛身下铺了干稻草。

studio.en: The band recorded their new song in a studio.
studio.zh: 乐队在录音室里录制了他们的新歌。

subjective.en: His opinion about the film is very subjective.
subjective.zh: 他对这部电影的看法非常主观。

substitute.en: You can substitute honey for sugar in this cake.
substitute.zh: 做这个蛋糕时你可以用蜂蜜代替糖。

subtraction.en: Tom is learning addition and subtraction at school this year.
subtraction.zh: 汤姆今年在学校学习加法和减法。

suck.en: The baby began to suck milk from the bottle.
suck.zh: 婴儿开始从奶瓶里吸奶。

suite.en: They stayed in a large suite on the top floor.
suite.zh: 他们住在顶楼一间宽敞的套房里。

summary.en: Please write a short summary of the story.
summary.zh: 请给这个故事写一段简短的摘要。

sunburnt.en: Amy came back from the beach with sunburnt shoulders.
sunburnt.zh: 艾米从海滩回来时肩膀晒黑了。

sunlight.en: The room gets a lot of sunlight in the morning.
sunlight.zh: 这个房间早上阳光很充足。

sunshine.en: We sat in the warm sunshine and talked for hours.
sunshine.zh: 我们坐在温暖的阳光下聊了几个小时。

superb.en: The food at that small restaurant was superb.
superb.zh: 那家小餐馆的饭菜非常出色。

superman.en: He dressed up as Superman for the school party.
superman.zh: 他在学校聚会上打扮成了超人。

supreme.en: The king had supreme power over the whole country.
supreme.zh: 国王对整个国家拥有至高无上的权力。

surface.en: The surface of the lake was calm and clear.

surplus.en: The farm sells its surplus vegetables at the market.
surplus.zh: 农场把剩余的蔬菜拿到市场上卖。

suspension.en: The player got a two-week suspension for breaking the rules.
suspension.zh: 那名球员因违反规则被停赛两周。

swell.en: His ankle began to swell after the fall.
swell.zh: 摔倒之后他的脚踝开始肿起来。

swimming pool.en: The children swim in the swimming pool every Sunday.
swimming pool.zh: 孩子们每个星期天都在游泳池里游泳。

swing.en: He swung the bag over his shoulder and left.
swing.zh: 他把包甩到肩上就离开了。

sword.en: The knight carried a long sword in his hand.
sword.zh: 那位骑士手里握着一把长剑。

systematic.en: He took a systematic approach to learning new words.
systematic.zh: 他采用系统的方法学习新单词。

table tennis.en: We play table tennis after class on Fridays.
table tennis.zh: 我们每周五放学后打乒乓球。

tablet.en: Take one tablet three times a day after meals.
tablet.zh: 每天三次，每次一片，饭后服用。

tanker.en: A large tanker was sailing slowly into the port.
tanker.zh: 一艘大油轮正缓缓驶进港口。

tape recorder.en: My grandma still uses an old tape recorder.
tape recorder.zh: 我奶奶还在用一台旧的磁带录音机。

tasteless.en: The soup was tasteless because I forgot the salt.
tasteless.zh: 汤没有味道，因为我忘了放盐。

tax-free.en: Perfume is tax-free if you buy it at the airport.
tax-free.zh: 在机场买的香水是免税的。

taxipayer.en: Every taxpayer must pay money to the government each year.
taxipayer.zh: 每个纳税人每年都必须向政府交钱。

teamwork.en: Good teamwork helped our class win the game.
teamwork.zh: 良好的合作帮助我们班赢得了比赛。

tease.en: The boys often tease Mary about her new glasses.
tease.zh: 男孩们常拿玛丽的新眼镜取笑她。

technical.en: The machine broke down because of a technical problem.
technical.zh: 这台机器因技术问题出了故障。

technique.en: She learned a new technique for painting trees.
technique.zh: 她学会了一种画树的新技巧。

telegraph.en: He telegraphed the good news to his parents.
telegraph.zh: 他用电报把这个好消息告诉了父母。

tension.en: There was tension between the two teams before the match.
tension.zh: 比赛前两队之间气氛紧张。

tentative.en: We made a tentative plan for the weekend trip.
tentative.zh: 我们为周末的旅行做了一个初步的计划。

terminal.en: The bus stopped at the terminal at six o'clock.
terminal.zh: 公共汽车六点到达了终点站。

terror.en: She ran away in terror when she saw the snake.
terror.zh: 她看到那条蛇时惊恐地跑开了。

thankful.en: I am thankful to Tom for all his help.
thankful.zh: 我很感激汤姆给我的所有帮助。

theirs.en: The red car near the gate is theirs.
theirs.zh: 大门口那辆红色的车是他们的。

theoretical.en: His idea is interesting but only theoretical at the moment.
theoretical.zh: 他的想法很有意思，但目前只是理论上的。

therefore.en: It was raining, therefore we stayed at home.
therefore.zh: 当时正在下雨，因此我们留在家里。

thriller.en: She read a thriller about a missing child.
thriller.zh: 她读了一本关于失踪儿童的惊险小说。

thunderstorm.en: A heavy thunderstorm woke us up last night.
thunderstorm.zh: 昨晚一场大雷雨把我们吵醒了。

thus.en: He studied hard and thus passed the exam.
thus.zh: 他努力学习，因而通过了考试。

tibet.en: My uncle travelled to Tibet by train last summer.
tibet.zh: 我叔叔去年夏天坐火车去了西藏。

tibeta.en: A Tibetan guide showed us the mountain village.
tibeta.zh: 一位藏族向导带我们参观了那个山村。

tiresomev.en: The long speech was tiresome for everyone.
tiresomev.zh: 那个冗长的演讲让每个人都感到厌倦。

tissue.en: The doctor looked at the tissue under a microscope.
tissue.zh: 医生在显微镜下观察这种组织。

ton.en: The truck carried five tons of sand to the site.
ton.zh: 卡车把五吨沙子运到了工地。

tournament.en: Our school won the basketball tournament last week.
tournament.zh: 我们学校上周赢得了篮球锦标赛。

traffic lights.en: Turn left at the traffic lights and drive slowly.
traffic lights.zh: 在红绿灯处向左转，然后慢慢开。

tram.en: We took a tram to the old part of town.
tram.zh: 我们乘有轨电车去了老城区。

transform.en: The new lights transformed the whole room.
transform.zh: 新的灯光使整个房间焕然一新。

transparent.en: The water in the lake is clean and transparent.

trend.en: There is a growing trend of working from home.
trend.zh: 在家办公的趋势正在增长。

triangle.en: He drew a small triangle on the paper.
triangle.zh: 他在纸上画了一个小三角形。

trolley-bus.en: A trolley-bus stopped in front of our school.
trolley-bus.zh: 一辆无轨电车停在我们学校门前。

trooping.en: The children were trooping into the hall noisily.
trooping.zh: 孩子们吵吵嚷嚷地成群走进大厅。

troop.en: The troops returned home after a long year.
troop.zh: 部队在漫长的一年之后回到了家乡。

troublesome.en: The little dog is sweet but sometimes troublesome.
troublesome.zh: 这只小狗很可爱，但有时也令人烦恼。

turning n.en: The shop is just around the next turning.
turning n.zh: 那家商店就在下一个拐角处。

tutor.en: Mary's tutor comes to her house every Saturday morning.
tutor.zh: 玛丽的家庭教师每周六早上来她家。

twenty-first.en: Her birthday is on the twenty-first of May.
twenty-first.zh: 她的生日是五月二十一日。

typewriter.en: My grandfather wrote letters on an old typewriter.
typewriter.zh: 我祖父用一台旧打字机写信。

unconditional.en: Parents give their children unconditional love.
unconditional.zh: 父母给孩子无条件的爱。

underground.en: We took the underground to the museum.
underground.zh: 我们乘地铁去了博物馆。

underline.en: Please underline the new words in the text.
underline.zh: 请在课文中的生词下面画线。

undertake.en: She agreed to undertake the difficult task alone.
undertake.zh: 她同意独自承担这项艰难的任务。

undivided.en: He gave his undivided attention to the teacher.
undivided.zh: 他全神贯注地听老师讲课。

unfold.en: He unfolded the map on the kitchen table.
unfold.zh: 他在厨房的桌子上展开了地图。

unhealthy.en: Eating too much sugar is unhealthy for children.
unhealthy.zh: 吃太多糖对孩子来说不健康。

unimportant.en: Do not worry about such unimportant details.
unimportant.zh: 不要为这些不重要的细节担心。

unite.en: The two villages united to build a new bridge.
unite.zh: 两个村庄联合起来建了一座新桥。

unrest.en: There was unrest in the city after the election.
unrest.zh: 选举之后城里出现了骚动。

unsafe.en: The old bridge is unsafe for heavy trucks.
unsafe.zh: 这座旧桥对重型卡车来说不安全。

unsuccessful.en: His first try was unsuccessful, but he kept going.
unsuccessful.zh: 他第一次尝试没有成功，但他继续努力。

untrue.en: The story about the ghost is completely untrue.
untrue.zh: 关于那个鬼的故事完全是假的。

unwilling.en: Tom was unwilling to speak in front of others.
unwilling.zh: 汤姆不愿意在别人面前讲话。

upward.en: The balloon rose upward into the blue sky.

user.en: Every user must set a strong password.
user.zh: 每个用户都必须设置一个强密码。

vanilla.en: I would like a vanilla ice cream, please.

vcd.en: We watched an old film on a VCD.
vcd.zh: 我们用影碟看了一部老电影。

veal.en: The restaurant serves veal with fresh vegetables.
veal.zh: 这家餐馆供应配新鲜蔬菜的小牛肉。

vehicle.en: No vehicle is allowed to park here.
vehicle.zh: 这里不允许任何车辆停放。

vertical.en: Draw a vertical line down the middle.
vertical.zh: 从中间向下画一条垂直线。

via.en: We flew to Paris via London last month.
via.zh: 上个月我们经伦敦飞往巴黎。

videophone.en: My father bought a new videophone for the office.
videophone.zh: 我父亲为办公室买了一部新的可视电话。

viewer.en: The show has millions of viewers around the world.
viewer.zh: 这个节目在全世界有数百万观众。

villager.en: A friendly villager showed us the way home.
villager.zh: 一位友好的村民给我们指了回家的路。

vinegar.en: Add a little vinegar to the salad.

violate.en: Drivers who violate the rules must pay a fine.
violate.zh: 违反规则的司机必须交罚款。

violence.en: The police are trying to stop violence in the city.
violence.zh: 警方正努力制止城里的暴力行为。

violent.en: A violent storm hit the coast last night.
violent.zh: 昨晚一场猛烈的风暴袭击了海岸。

violinist.en: She wants to become a famous violinist one day.
violinist.zh: 她希望有一天成为著名的小提琴手。

virtue.en: Honesty is a virtue that everyone should have.
virtue.zh: 诚实是每个人都应具备的美德。

visual.en: The film is famous for its amazing visual effects.
visual.zh: 这部电影以惊人的视觉效果闻名。

vital.en: Water is vital to all living things.
vital.zh: 水对一切生物都至关重要。

vivid.en: She gave a vivid description of the accident.
vivid.zh: 她生动地描述了那场事故。

voluntary.en: He does voluntary work at the hospital on Sundays.
voluntary.zh: 他每周日在医院做志愿工作。

volunteer.en: Many students volunteer to help at the sports meeting.
volunteer.zh: 许多学生自愿在运动会上帮忙。

waiting -room.en: We sat in the waiting room for half an hour.
waiting -room.zh: 我们在候诊室坐了半个小时。

walkman.en: My brother listens to music on his old walkman.
walkman.zh: 我哥哥用他的旧随身听听音乐。

wander.en: We wandered through the quiet streets of the town.
wander.zh: 我们在小镇安静的街道上漫步。

ward.en: The nurse took us to the children's ward.
ward.zh: 护士把我们带到了儿童病房。

warm-hearted.en: Our warm-hearted neighbour often helps the old lady.
warm-hearted.zh: 我们热心的邻居常常帮助那位老太太。

warmth.en: The warmth of the fire made us sleepy.
warmth.zh: 火的温暖让我们感到困倦。

washing -machine.en: Our washing machine has been broken for a week.
washing -machine.zh: 我们的洗衣机已经坏了一个星期。

washroom.en: The washroom is at the end of the hall.

wave.en: She waved goodbye to her friends at the station.
wave.zh: 她在车站向朋友们挥手告别。

wax.en: The candle is made of wax and a string.
wax.zh: 蜡烛是用蜡和一根线做成的。

wayside.en: We stopped at a wayside restaurant for lunch.
wayside.zh: 我们在一家路边餐馆停下来吃午饭。

web.en: A spider was building a web in the corner.
web.zh: 一只蜘蛛正在角落里结网。

weekday.en: I work in the city on every weekday.
weekday.zh: 我每个工作日都在城里上班。

weekly.en: We have a weekly meeting on Monday.

western.en: The western part of the country is very dry.
western.zh: 这个国家的西部非常干燥。

westerner.en: A westerner may find these customs strange.
westerner.zh: 西方人可能会觉得这些习俗很奇怪。

westwards.en: The ship sailed westwards at dawn.

whom.en: The man whom I met yesterday was very kind.
whom.zh: 我昨天遇到的那个人非常和善。

wildlife.en: The park is famous for its wildlife.
wildlife.zh: 这座公园以野生动物闻名。

willingness.en: She showed great willingness to help us.
willingness.zh: 她表现出很强的帮助我们的意愿。

windbreaker.en: Take a windbreaker with you; it is windy outside.
windbreaker.zh: 带件风衣吧，外面风很大。

wire.en: A small bird sat on the wire.

wisdom.en: Old people often have great wisdom.

withdraw.en: The army had to withdraw from the town.
withdraw.zh: 军队不得不撤出那座城镇。

woo.en: This warm coat is made of soft wool.
woo.zh: 这件暖和的外套是柔软羊毛做的。

workforce.en: Half of the workforce is under thirty.
workforce.zh: 一半的劳动力不到三十岁。

workmate.en: My workmate helped me finish the report.
workmate.zh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。

workplace.en: The workplace must be safe and clean.
workplace.zh: 工作场所必须安全整洁。

world-famous.en: The small town is world-famous for its tea.
world-famous.zh: 这座小镇以茶闻名世界。

worldwide.zh: 这支乐队在全世界都很受欢迎。

worthwhile.en: It is worthwhile to learn a second language.
worthwhile.zh: 学一门第二语言是值得的。

wrinkle.en: There is a wrinkle in his new shirt.
wrinkle.zh: 他的新衬衫上有一道褶皱。

yoghurt.en: I eat yoghurt with fruit for breakfast.

yummy.zh: 这块蛋糕看起来真好吃。

zebra -crossing.en: Please cross the road at the zebra crossing.

zone.en: Cars are not allowed in this zone.
zone.zh: 这个区域不允许汽车通行。

zoom.en: The plane will zoom over the city.
zoom.zh: 飞机会快速掠过城市上空。

ad..en: I saw a short ad for the new phone.
ad..zh: 我看到了一个关于这款新手机的短广告。

café.en: We met in a small café near the station.
café.zh: 我们在车站附近一家小咖啡馆见了面。

e-mail/email.en: Please send me an email with the details.
e-mail/email.zh: 请把细节用电子邮件发给我。

egypt*.en: Egypt is famous for its ancient pyramids.
egypt*.zh: 埃及以古老的金字塔闻名。

england*.en: England is part of the United Kingdom.
england*.zh: 英格兰是联合王国的一部分。

europe*.en: Many tourists visit Europe every summer.
europe*.zh: 每年夏天都有许多游客去欧洲旅行。

france*.en: France is well known for its wine.

grey / gray.en: He wore a grey coat and a warm hat.
grey / gray.zh: 他穿着一件灰色外套，戴着一顶暖和的帽子。

lost & found.en: Ask at the lost and found for your bag.
lost & found.zh: 去失物招领处问问你的包。

madam/ madame.en: Madam, your table is ready now.
madam/ madame.zh: 女士，您的餐桌准备好了。

miss..en: Miss Li teaches us English every morning.
miss..zh: 李老师每天早上教我们英语。

mr..en: Mr Wang works in a bank near here.
mr..zh: 王先生在这儿附近的一家银行工作。

mrs..en: Mrs Green lives next door to us.
mrs..zh: 格林太太住在我们隔壁。

ms..en: Ms Chen is our new manager.
ms..zh: 陈女士是我们的新经理。

oˈclock.en: The class starts at eight o'clock.

p.m./pm, p.m. /pm.en: The shop closes at nine p.m.

soft sɔft;.en: She likes soft music before sleeping.
soft sɔft;.zh: 她喜欢睡前听轻柔的音乐。

spain*.en: Spain won the match last night.
spain*.zh: 西班牙昨晚赢了那场比赛。

spoken man/ woman.en: The spokesman answered questions from reporters.
spoken man/ woman.zh: 发言人回答了记者的提问。

statesman/ woman.en: He was a great statesman and a wise leader.
statesman/ woman.zh: 他是一位伟大的政治家和睿智的领袖。

telephone-booth / telephone-box.en: She called him from a telephone booth.
telephone-booth / telephone-box.zh: 她在一个电话亭里给他打了电话。
